name: HAVOC Rifle
Lore: While the origin of the HAVOC is unknown, it's believed to be a custom build fashioned for a Devotion LMG fan with money to burn. A versatile energy rifle, the HAVOC is meant to mimic the behavior of a Devotion with the increased accuracy of an assault rifle and fewer attachments to reach maximum output. Some might call it "streamlined", but a certain mystery buyer would probably choose "tailor-made" instead.
